candidate_claim_not_credited_as_statemen: For each fixed graph F with chromatic number r + 1 at least 3 and each positive epsilon, there exist positive delta and a natural n0 such that every F-free simple graph G on n at least n0 vertices whose edge count is at least (1 - 1/r - delta) * n^2 / 2 differs from the balanced r-partite Turan graph in at most epsilon * n^2 edges, after the source-selected relabeling convention.

Exact universe serialization, decidability instances, relabeling convention, and casts remain open.
